notes.title: 🥗 Dine Out DLC Devlog - 2 weeks until RELEASE! 🎊
notes.notes:
Hello, Flippers! 🏠

The 26th is right around the corner, and I hope you’re all ready for the release of Dine Out DLC! We all know how it feels to wait for a DLC to a game we like, and with that in mind, we’ve decided to give you the last bit of insight into the DLC!

[hr][/hr]
Order up! 🧾

Let’s start where every restaurant meal starts… Right at the table with our guests!
Enjoy your surroundings and choose something tasty from the menu.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/6901cd031421dac172b0d42fcb5692692a62a1d1.png
Are we thinking of some fancy dinner here? 

Is the fancy interior not to your liking? My esteemed guests, we can arrange a different table for you. Maybe this cosy little cafe will be more to your liking?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/068d39f2b8e5247a04f3b1dafa0c5280b5c10817.png
I’ll take a latte and a… Cream puff!

Oh, you need a table for many? That can be arranged. We have a lovely spot with a perfect view of the river and an old castle. Is it closer to your personal taste? Perfect. We’ll have everything arranged for you.

[hr][/hr]
Yes, Chef! 🧑‍🍳

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/075cf4107b355d769084920949ae99b8dbe39690.png
We have a big order coming! Prepare your workstations and pots!

Let’s slow down with this restaurant talk for now… 
As you all know, House Flipper is and always will be a game about renovations. Dine Out is just another stop in your Flipping journey; you should look at it that way. We’ve prepared a lot of new furniture for you to recreate or design your kitchens, restaurants and other buildings in the game. We created tools for your imagination, and just in a bit, you’ll be able to use them in your creations.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/a3151df3debf457054e12d4180399c9d47ccdce2.png
The kitchen’s all ready and waiting for you!

And with all that kitchen stuff, there’s one more thing that’ll make you hungry in no time…

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/f2d1f9ee413cf29149b54d84dc2f818801d41d65.gif

[hr][/hr]
Time to set up the table! 🍽️

As the title says, with everything ready, we can finally set up that table by the river. Enjoy the scenery with that little gallery!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/7a38517ebd9ed91ed7d095461e537c817e1d9df4.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/8940fb7857d04806b5d4f1c3f6d9f51acc2dba6c.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/aed48324839ef71f7286fba6c26c8fed28b6f39d.jpg

And with that, we’ve arrived nearly at the end of this devlog. In almost two weeks, you’ll be able to create similar creations with Dine Out DLC, amongst other new features introduced in the DLC.

But before we close it all off, here’s a sneak peek at an item we’re adding with the new content… 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/1e55b587377d183cea5d30dd6f6e077be9572026.gif

Thank you for sticking with us until the very end! We would like to invite you to our discord personally. We’re always looking forward to hearing your feedback! And if you haven’t already be sure to add Dine Out DLC to your Wishlist!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2819590/House_Flipper__Dine_Out_DLC/

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/5681f6b4bd956fa3b53a985d5352b1d1105a72eb.png

See you at the premiere!

notes.title: 🥩 Dine Out DLC Devlog + Historical Museum Update! 🦕
notes.notes:
Hello, Flippers!

Welcome to the latest Dine Out DLC development update, freshly crafted just for you. Settle in and get ready for a feast of exciting new features and updates!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2819590/House_Flipper__Dine_Out_DLC/

[hr][/hr]
BUT FIRST! 🤩

We have a little surprise for you! The completely free Historical Museum Update for House Flipper is now available! Inside, you'll find not only a new house but also over 35 new objects inspired by history! The update also brings several minor optimizations to improve the game's performance. We are constantly working to provide you with the best gaming experience possible. Thank you for being with us!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/2a6458cb4a5d8e13699a335c5ba9451fd866a8b8.gif

[hr][/hr]
It’s time to lay out the fancy stuff…

Regarding the Dine Out DLC, we've been busy lately, crafting new content for you. First up, we're introducing fresh mechanics specifically designed for this DLC. Next, we have a useful addition to the Universal Cooker to enhance your kitchen projects. Plus, there's a sneak peek at some of the new houses you'll be able to renovate. And at the end, we've gathered a variety of items to inspire and expand your decorating ideas. We're excited to share this Devlog with you.

Let’s talk a bit about the new mechanic we’re rolling out in the Dine Out DLC.
Table cloths are an important part of every fancy restaurant. With that in mind we’re developing a tool that will give you a way to add this type of decoration to most of the tables in the game!
It’s time to cut some cloth! Length of every tablecloth can be adjusted at the moment of placement!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/935350b59f3ff429b9bd128dcca331cdd174ca73.gif
Let’s try not to leave any stains 

With the table ready to be served, your freshly renovated restaurant is the talk of the town! Now, get ready for a delicious twist in House Flipper! 
Remember the Universal Cooker we introduced earlier? You'll now have access to a new addition – the Cookbook, where all your recipes will be automatically saved. Kick things off with a few starters to create amazing dishes that add a unique flair to your renovated eateries. Unlock even more culinary creations as you progress with flipping!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/1ddc213cf025a593ec218122b6e960f9756c4c80.pngHonestly, I’m down for some Bibimbap 😋

[hr][/hr]
Let’s go back to the basics for a moment…

We can’t forget that House Flipper is still a game about flipping. We’ve heard your voices and we want to assure you that the new DLC doesn’t change the whole main aspect of the game. To back our words we’ve decided to show you some spots in need of flipping. 👀

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/cbaa00fd07b65cb3fee717d3c362a974f6a63d7d.pngMaybe we could somehow use those pool tables…

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/493650632db622a4ee01e344fa6a26577e631a8f.pngIs that a Frozen District t-shirt?!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/ebce189b5898e9efcdbac50c1cb2a7faf936491e.pngIf we get rid of those crates it’ll be sooo spacious!

[hr][/hr]
Let there be light! 💡

In a previous Devlog, we’ve told you about the new Neons that are coming along with Dine Out. Today it’s time to show you one more thing we’re working on regarding them. We wanted to give you a mechanic that’ll allow you to create your own Neon Writings!

Shine in the spotlight thanks to the Neon customisation mechanic! Wake up your inner artist and adjust them accordingly to your taste. You can create your personalized text, change its size, adjust light intensity, choose your favorite font, and more.

We're all ears for your opinion so let us know - will you add neon to your renovated restaurant? Do you like the vibe? We're waiting in the comments section.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/1d761e4cea9d6a2e54a65bf7ccdf91efc3304c39.gif
“Shapes and colors the lights of which I’ve never seen”

[hr][/hr]
“Meet interesting People they said…”

Alright, Flippers, meet Sebastian and Layla. Two new characters from this DLC. 

They're in need of your expert renovation skills. Both have exciting projects and unique visions, and they’re counting on you to bring them to life. Sebastian values efficiency and determination, while Layla is all about ambition and hard work.

They both dream big and look forward to seeing how you can transform their spaces.Where do you think these characters would want their dream renovations? Dive into their stories and help them achieve their goals!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/14fb919659c01ee7c1d138f2761ccfb9269b52aa.pngMeet our Fiery two!

[hr][/hr]
All good things come to an end…

Thank you for sticking with us until the very end! We want to use this occasion to inform you that the Steam Summer Sale lasts till tomorrow, so it's your last chance to grab any House Flipper franchise games and DLCs you're still missing! 👀
https://steamcommunity.com/games/613100/announcements/detail/4271182997359351514

Have a great rest of the week and let us know how you feel about the path of development we're taking with Dine Out DLC.

Kudos from all the House Flipper developers! ❤️❤️

notes.title: Another bug bites the dust - New Farm DLC hotfix!
notes.notes:
Howdy, Flippers!

We've been away for a while, but we're back with another batch of fixes. We're constantly looking to enhance your gaming experience, so check out what's been fixed. 
ps: don't forget to update your game and make sure you have the correct version [release] 1.23204 (3e183)

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1832960/House_Flipper__Farm_DLC/ 

General fixes:
 Fixed the sorting of newest items.
 Stairs will no longer be automatically sold when selling a nearby window.
 Fixed an issue that prevented the full installation of the anti-gravity lift when using a gamepad.
 Fixed a variety of wall glitches that occurred when placing two doors in the same segment.
 Weed removal quests will no longer appear unless the Garden DLC is installed.
 Mobile scaffolding will no longer go out of bounds.
 Placing down a Mobile Scaffolding will now automatically reset it to base height.
 Purchasing doors without sufficient funds will no longer lead to endless wall destruction.
 Painted ceiling tiles will now save their progress consistently.
 Fixed loose wall segments left by the hammer during very wide door installations.
 Fixed mismatched collisions on “Taggy stacked staircase” item.
Animal fixes:
 Chickens will now utilize all three nests in the triple chicken nest item.
 Added new icons for grooming cows, horses, and goats.
 Fixed cyclic frame stutters caused by farm animals.
 The AI of farm animals has been enhanced to reduce instances of them getting their heads stuck inside walls.
Map fixes:
 Increased the size of the Ladder Room in the "Thank You Renovation" order.
 Restored missing balcony previews on “Grandpa’s Summer Surprise” order.
 Unseen floors in Pets DLC and Farm DLC maps will no longer be rendered, resulting in a notable performance improvement.

General fixes and changes:

Dogs will now properly get dirty over time, depending on their cleanliness-related perks.
Cats will now jump and play on their wall playgrounds.
Fixed the issue where swapped walls weren't saved.
Fixed the issue where pets would spawn outside of their enclosures.
Improved spawning mechanics of pets when changing maps, they will attempt to spawn on the same height as the player if possible, instead of skipping whole floors.
Pets can no longer be put down on roofs.
Added meaningful distinction between male and female Iguanas and changed their animation in Morgan’s Pet Care.
You can now place items on Listan patterned under the bowl mat.
Guinea pigs will no longer spin in place by following the same spot.
Fixed an issue where the parrot would get stuck in some actions.
Fixed player animation repeating when feeding the hamster.
Fixed laying in bed issues for Couch Archaic variants.
Fixed a bug where carrying a pet could allow a player to place multiple laptops
Fixed an issue where cats would get stuck on placed windows.
Cats will no longer completely freeze if you sell a window the cat was planning to jump to.
Fixed an issue with some items being unsellable after your pet stops sitting on them.
Cats will no longer teleport to the next floor or roof after jumping to the window.
Removed visual clutter from some interaction menu buttons.
The dog's jaw will no longer slowly clip through the toy during the catch.
Fixed an issue where a dog would walk next to the toy and just look at it instead of catching it.
Fixed stairs sometimes not generating proper conditions for your pets to use them.
Fixed the movement of pets on some stairs.
Adjusted placement of the Parrot during eating action.
Fixed an issue with being unable to feed the fish.
Morgan’s Pet Care now only has female spiders to take care of.
A slider will now appear in the pet cage selection menu and fixed navigation via pad.
Fixed an issue where the dog’s position will wildly jitter when playing tug of war near weeds.
Pulling interaction will now properly be ended if the dog ends up in the air.
Pulling toys and paint cans will no longer disappear when the interaction is initiated between rooms.
Cats will no longer get stuck attempting to go through the door clap.
Fixed the door being sellable and pickable after a cat going through the door clap.
Fixed tablet thumbnails for variants of tents, a garden gnome, and Euphorbia milii.
Fixed interaction and selling issues for the item, Kevin Small Triple Window 2.5 x 1.45 m

Harper windows will no longer flick after being opened.
You can now interact with the treadmill to call your dog to it.

Business As Usual (Job—Luxury):
Fixed walking area issues for pets, which made them go into unreachable places.
Poppy House (House—Pets):
Basement stairs that are part of the building can no longer be sold.
Snuggly Hideaway (House—Pets):
It is now possible to install doors and windows on the ground floor around the stairs.
Historic House (House—Luxury):
Fixed stairs being transparent during tiling.
Fixed loose stairs parts sticking out of the ceiling.

Two in One (Job—Luxury), A Job You Can’t Refuse (Job—Luxury), Closed Laundry (House—Luxury), and Top-notch Apartment (House—Luxury):
Fixed the issue where ceilings would appear black.
Classic Manor House (House—Luxury):
Destroying walls around the stairs will no longer expose the next floor.
The One To Flip (House—Base Game) and The One To Move In (House—Base Game):
It is now possible to install Mary windows
A New Player In Town (Job—Luxury):
Fixed the issue causing duplicated shutter installation quests.
Garage With Bunker (House—Apocalypse):
Cockroaches/Glass will no longer clip through the floor.
Uncle’s Bunker (House—Apocalypse):
The roof above the entrance will no longer flicker.
Alleyway of Lights (House - Cyberpunk):
Snowflakes will no longer be visible on ECO lightning mode.
Garage With Bunker (House—Apocalypse):
Filled in a hole near the hatch.
House After The Flood (House-Base Game):
Stains on the floor will no longer flicker.
Man Cave (House-Base Game):
Stains in the basement will no longer appear on the minimap of the ground floor.
Hucker’s House (House—Base Game):
Fixed the drastic FPS drop after painting the ceiling below the roof.

notes.title: Pets DLC improvements and patch notes #2!
notes.notes:
Hey, Flippers!

As you already know, we're constantly trying to improve our brand new DLC, according to your feedback. Since our last patch notes, we've managed to fix some additional issues reported by our community, but most importantly, we added a teleport mechanic that helps your pets move around stairs. Most of you (if not every one of you, yikes) have been asking for it, so we're more than happy to implement it into the game! Like the previous patch notes, we've prepared a separate list for general issues and house/order-related fixes.

Quick disclaimer: Read till the end because we might have some surprises for you! But for now, let's get the bugs out of our house! 



General fixes and changes:

Dogs, cats, and bunnies will now move between floors on their own via internal staircases, with no need to carry them up or down.
You can now put up to two guinea pigs inside one enclosure, instead of only one.
Improved pet randomization in Morgan’s Pet Care and fixed the issue with new pets not generating in the next refresh cycle if all of them were taken by the player.
Cat hairballs are produced much less frequently now.
Adjusted mouth position of held dog toys and held paint cans to better fit each dog.
Your dogs will now drop held toys when you open their interaction menu, in a similar fashion to dropping held paint.
Your dogs can no longer carry paint when holding a toy in their mouth and vice versa.
Fixed paint cans having collision when carried by dogs, as well as randomly disappearing when carried in rare instances.
Fixed the issue with turtles getting stuck spinning indefinitely.
Fixed issues regarding feeding the turtle, the food will no longer disappear and interaction will properly fill out the bowl without the need for multiple feedings.
Fixed positions of cats laying on objects.
Rebalanced the timing of the pet needs and their behavior on jobs.
Fixed pets changing their colors when the game is reloaded.
Fixed some doors with little pet doors not having their intended functionality.
Fixed an issue with being unable to feed the hamster.
Fixed hamster’s cage keytips.
Fixed house recognition issues when the player is on the roof.


House/Job specific fixes and changes:

The AnimalCaretaker:
Fixed the issue with door frame deletion causing the wall to be filled out despite another door frame being present.
Fixed issues related to selling the bathtub and its mounting point.

Lets Rock Right Meow
(House) - Fixed wall near the balcony on the second floor being unpaintable.

KameHouse:
Adjusted walking for pets, preventing them from floating in the air.



Okay now... How about the magic trick? From now on, you don't need to carry your doggos, kitties, and bunnies anymore! We gave them a pinch of magic so that everyone could feel a little Harry Potter vibes! As mentioned above, teleportation is a real thing. It's a kind of magic, isn't it?

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1120320/Builder_Simulator/

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/2f4068d3a6920f1b5d8e4d421b97fe47a2b33dc0.png


That would be it for today’s development update, flippers. If you have any questions or ideas regarding House Flipper – Pets DLC or Builder Simulator, feel free to let us know in the comments below or on our discord channel.

Have a lovely time flipping!

~ Frozen District & Frozen Way teams!

Rope of the cat rod no longer bounces endlessly.

Be aware that we’re going to develop House Flipper for another day, weeks and months, adding more new items (colors, furniture, tiles), functionalities, not stopping to make the game better and better. 

Time’s about to be up! Let’s go smash some walls! 
Cheers Flippers!

- House Flipper Development Team

notes.title: Release Date Change (Update)
notes.notes:
Hey House Flippers!

    The last week for us was filled with intensive work on House Flipper. We hired a squadron of professional testers and we received from you lot of suggestions about the game. Your voice in the production of House Flipper was very important to us, and this time we also want to heed your voice! 

    We are just a step away from the release and we want to be sure that the game will bring you lots of fun, regardless of whether you play on a PC or Mac, in English, Ukrainian or Korean. We could release the game tomorrow, but this would be a waste of your feedback and the support that you have given us. We need to ask you to be a little more patient, while ensuring you that the deadline for releasing the game on Steam is May 17, 2018 at 15:00 UTC. 

House Flipper Team

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Update
We were considering early access, but there are many reasons not to do that.
[olist]
We'd need to come out of Early Access on 2017-05-17 anyway, because then we are publishing full version of the game.
This date is final and we have signed contracts for box version in retail stores in many countries.

It would be bad for a game - now we can fix and improve things quickly, not supporting thousands of players, and not having to handle backwards compability (i.e. saves). After release it will be different.

Releasing on Early Access is a process that has requirements and takes time! 
You need to request it, prepare information about the current state of game, go through whole acceptance process on Steam, update website according to Steam requirements, etc. 
It could easily take more than a month anyway.
[/olist]

Important note:

    Although we do not publish the game as an Early Access title, we will improve the game for many months after the release. We plan to add new houses, appraisers, mechanics and items. We hope that you'll support us in doing so.
